curves-write-c16.pdf.note: Native/TH: one full-matrix run; others: median over 2–6 GCP runs (different fleets, days, binaries); hardware/configuration not fully matched. Native: 1 process / 1 SSD. Tidehunter: 5 configured owners. Other external contributors record five configured or observed storage nodes; Cassandra's 3 November run records five contacts, not a verified five-node ring. Five storage-host SSD mounts attested only for inspected 4 November/final deployments. FoundationDB has a separate log/coordinator host. Even spread is not measured. 4,096 successful puts/point/run; finite exposure, not sustained capacity. X: K = 1024 bytes. Y: k = 1000, M = 10⁶. Cache paths differ; no SSD-read claim. Native: per-put file + directory fsync; TH: covering fdatasync; Valkey: AOF always. Kvrocks: synced WAL; Garnet: AOF commit. Hollow: Cassandra/FDB/TiKV persistence unverified.
